intro.t: The day of the LORD, again.
b: Judgment on Judah and the nations, followed by a promise of a humble remnant. Chapter 3 ends with God rejoicing over his people with singing.

3.h: He will rejoice over you with singing
3.t: An unexpectedly tender verse at the end of a fierce book.

1.t: Described as wine left on its dregs, who say the LORD will do nothing either good or bad. Indifference judged as sharply as rebellion.

2.h: Seek the LORD, all you humble
2.t: Perhaps you will be sheltered on the day of his anger. Hope offered to the humble inside a book of judgement.
